permit.quote: Thereafter, we will still retain it as necessary to comply with our legal obligations, resolve disputes, establish and defend legal claims and enforce our agreements.

prohibit.quote: Upon the termination of the agreement with us for the provision of the Platform, we will return or delete you Business Information, unless we are required to retain such information under applicable law.

conflicts.situation: After a Business ends its Platform agreement, Singular keeps the representative's Contact Information to resolve a dispute or defend a legal claim, without a legal retention requirement.
conflicts.reason: Both statements cover Business Information, defined as Inquiry, Analytics and Contact Information. One keeps it after use for disputes and claims. The other requires return or deletion after termination, excepting only legal requirements.

permit.quote: We will retain your Inquiry Information, Analytics Information and Contact Information for as long as we need it for business purposes, and thereafter as needed for record-keeping matters.

prohibit.quote: We will retain Business Information in accordance with the Business’s instructions and only while the Business uses the Platform.

conflicts.situation: A representative of a prospective Business submits an inquiry, the Business never uses the Platform, and Singular retains the Inquiry Information for marketing and record-keeping.
conflicts.reason: The policy defines Business Information as Inquiry, Analytics and Contact Information, so one statement allows retention for business needs while the other limits retention to the period the Business uses the Platform. No precedence is stated.

permit.quote: We share your personal information for behaviorally-targeted ads, as explained above.

prohibit.quote: We will not share your information with third parties, except in the events listed below or when you provide us your explicit and informed

conflicts.situation: A Website visitor's IP address, advertising ID and network activity are shared with advertising networks for behaviorally targeted ads without the visitor's explicit consent.
conflicts.reason: The exception list after the no-sharing statement names service providers, authorities, legal requirements, corporate group and structural change, but not advertising networks. The CPRA section discloses this sharing without saying it is an exception.

permit.quote: Recipients may include service providers acting on our behalf and third parties that process information for their own legally permitted purposes, such as app distribution platforms, Billing Providers, Payment Service Providers, professional advisers, regulators, and public authorities.

prohibit.quote: We do not sell or share your personal information with third parties.

conflicts.situation: Purchase and subscription identifiers are disclosed to a Billing Provider or app distribution platform, which processes them independently for its own fraud-prevention and accounting purposes.
conflicts.reason: The flat denial does not define 'share' in its narrow CCPA sense or exclude disclosures to independent recipients, while another section names third parties that receive data for their own purposes. No precedence is given.

prohibit.quote: We never sell or share children’s personal information for marketing purposes.

conflicts.situation: A child's device identifiers and in-app events from a children's app are sent to AppsFlyer for marketing attribution and campaign measurement.
conflicts.reason: AppsFlyer is listed as receiving child app device data for marketing analytics. The policy says it runs in COPPA-compliant mode but does not say whether attribution counts as a marketing purpose.

permit.quote: Such information may be linked to or combined with other personal information we process about you, such as your user ID

prohibit.quote: We do not link the information we store within the analytics software to any information that personally identifies you within the mobile application.

conflicts.situation: Usage and gameplay data collected by analytics SDKs is linked to the player's user ID to personalize recommendations.
conflicts.reason: Tracking technologies used by analytics service providers collect usage data that may be linked to the user ID, while the analytics section denies linking analytics data to identifying information. The policy does not say which governs.

permit.quote: Crazy Maple Studio may offer you the opportunity to invite your contacts from a Social Login platform (such as your Facebook friends) so that those contacts can be located in Crazy Maple Studio games and/or you can invite them to join you in our games.

prohibit.quote: Such contact information will be used only for the purpose of sending the invitation to the addressee(s).

conflicts.situation: A player imports Facebook friends, and Crazy Maple uses the contact data to locate which friends already play its games, without sending an invitation.
conflicts.reason: The same paragraph states that imported contacts can be located in the games and that the contact information is used only to send invitations. Locating contacts is a separate use with no stated exception.
